class.name: Spawner2D
class.brief_description: Spawns instances of a scene periodically.
class.description: Every [member interval] seconds, adds an instance of [member scene] to [member spawn_parent] (the spawner's parent by default), at a random point within [member spawn_radius]. Stops spawning while [member max_alive] instances are alive. Useful for enemies, pickups or waves.

method.name: get_alive_count
method.description: Returns how many spawned instances are still alive.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the spawner is active.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Spawns one instance right away and returns it, or [code]null[/code] if [member max_alive] was reached or [member scene] is not set.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], starts spawning when the node enters the scene.
Maximum number of spawned instances alive at the same time. [code]0[/code] means no limit.
Node the instances are added to. If empty, the spawner's parent is used, so instances don't move with the spawner.
Spawned instances are placed at a random point within this distance of the spawner.

signal.name: spawned
signal.description: Emitted when an instance is spawned.
